source.dataset: doi:10.5258/SOTON/D1747 (University of Southampton ePrints 449632, files MoSe2_Data.xlsx / WSe2_Data.xlsx, sheet 'Processed A1s Data')
source.paper: Viner, McDonnell, Ruiz-Tijerina, Rivera, Xu, Fal'ko, Smith 2021, 2D Materials 8, 035047 'Excited Rydberg States in MoSe2/WSe2 Heterostructures', arXiv:2103.09004 (doi not independently verified here)
source.figure: text and Supplementary Section S3 / Fig. S2 of the dataset paper (240 cm-1 A1' peak of monolayer MoSe2); excitation range 1.24-2.25 eV, all spectra at 4 K

notes: Processed spectrum as deposited (parallel minus crossed polarisation subtraction to remove PL, thin-film-interference corrected, absolute scattering probability x1e8; NOT raw counts). hBN-encapsulated monolayer, 4 K, resonance Raman near the A1s exciton at 1.6791 eV (738.4 nm). Excitation-dependent relative intensities: other weaker peaks exist but only the single-phonon peak whose position the paper states is listed. Si 520 cm-1 substrate peak may appear. Position 240 cm-1 is from the dataset's own paper; the companion paper (McDonnell et al. 2020, arXiv:2006.05912) gives 241.0 cm-1 for the same peak.
